subject: FieldScout: draft story — edits, fact-check & quote confirmation
messages:
From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Ellie Thompson <ellie.thompson@fieldscout.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: FieldScout: draft story — edits, fact-check & quote confirmation

Hi Ellie,

Great talking earlier — thanks again for the time and the great anecdotes about how FieldScout uses batch inference to speed up route planning. I've attached our first draft of the customer story (FieldScout_CaseDraft_v1.docx). Can you and Ben please:  
- Confirm the accuracy of the product flow section (pages 2–3), especially the sentence that references our "prefetch + KV cache" behavior;
- Fact-check the performance numbers listed under "Outcomes" (we called out ~37% reduction in per-route latency and 22% cost per route);
- Approve the quote we attributed to Ben on the final page or suggest alternative wording.

If you prefer, I can send a short redline-friendly copy in Google Docs — whatever's easiest. Hoping to get your feedback by end-of-week so we can include FieldScout in the July customer spotlight.

Attachments: FieldScout_CaseDraft_v1.docx (docx)

Thanks,
Mateo
Mateo Alvarez
Customer Marketing Manager, Redwood Inference
mateo.alvarez@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0142

---
Note: Redwood will anonymize any sensitive screenshots if you ask; we can also mask raw route IDs in the appendix.

From: Ellie Thompson <ellie.thompson@fieldscout.ai>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Crawford <ben.crawford@fieldscout.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2027 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: FieldScout: draft story — edits, fact-check & quote confirmation

Thanks Mateo — appreciate the draft. Ben and I reviewed and left a few redlines (attached). High-level notes:  
- The latency number on page 3 should be 31%, not 37% — that's the median improvement across live batches; the 37% was from a smaller internal test cohort.
- Can we remove the customer name in the screenshot on page 5? We need that anonymized.
- Ben would prefer a slightly shorter quote: "Redwood's runtime cut routing time in half and let us scale without major infra changes." He asked that we avoid the word "magic."

Inline response to the draft below (we used MS Track Changes in FS_redlines_v1.docx). If you can push an updated version that addresses the latency correction and screenshot, we can sign off quickly.

Thanks — Ellie
Ellie Thompson
Head of Product, FieldScout
ellie.thompson@fieldscout.ai | +1 312-555-0199

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Ellie Thompson <ellie.thompson@fieldscout.ai>, Ben Crawford <ben.crawford@fieldscout.ai>
Date: Wed, 23 Jun 2027 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: FieldScout: draft story — edits, fact-check & quote confirmation

Looping in a couple of quick edits from marketing/comms and a note from Legal:  
- Suggest tightening the opening paragraph — make it customer-first (swap the first two sentences). I can push a suggested first paragraph.
- On metrics: legal flagged that claims about percent improvements need a short footnote referencing the source dataset. Can you ask FieldScout to confirm the dataset and link (or allow us to use an anonymized internal chart)? I've included a tiny text file with the metrics sources we reference.
- Also, watch for product terminology: we should consistently use "prefetch" (one word) and avoid product-internal names like "route-optimizer-v2" in the public asset.

I'll draft the opening and push as tracked changes if that helps. Mateo — can you request the dataset link from Ellie (or provide confirmation that the 31% is the median across "live batches Q1–Q2 2027").

Thanks,
Marissa
Senior Customer Marketing Lead, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

Attachments: metrics_source_links.txt

From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Ellie Thompson <ellie.thompson@fieldscout.ai>, Ben Crawford <ben.crawford@fieldscout.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 24 Jun 2027 10:48:00 -0700
Subject: Updated draft: addressed redlines + metric correction (v2)

Hi Ellie and Ben —

Thanks for the quick review and the redlines. I've incorporated Ellie's wording change for the quote (shortened as requested), anonymized the screenshot, and corrected the latency improvement to 31% (we now call it "median per-route latency improvement: 31% — Q1–Q2 2027 live batches"). Marissa also suggested tightening the opener; you'll see that change in the first paragraph.

I've attached FieldScout_CaseDraft_v2.docx with tracked changes. A couple of small asks before we publish:  
1) Can Ben confirm the final quote line below:  
"Redwood's runtime cut routing time in half and let us scale without major infra changes."
2) Can FieldScout confirm permission to publish the anonymized chart in appendix B? We will not surface any raw route IDs.

If I don't hear back by EOD tomorrow, we'll plan to move forward with the anonymized screenshot and the 31% line.

Thanks again — Mateo
Mateo Alvarez
Customer Marketing Manager, Redwood Inference
mateo.alvarez@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0142

Attachments: FieldScout_CaseDraft_v2.docx

Subject: Re: Updated draft: addressed redlines + metric correction (v2)

Mateo — thanks for the updates. Confirming:  
- Quote approved as written: "Redwood's runtime cut routing time in half and let us scale without major infra changes."
- We approve the anonymized chart in appendix B (please keep the timestamps rounded to week granularity).

Quick request: please use the anonymized screenshot you attached rather than the original. Otherwise good to publish for your July spotlight.

Best,
Ben Crawford
CPO, FieldScout
ben.crawford@fieldscout.ai | +1 312-555-0166
